question: When the WBG-2 corpus is corrected to expose all eight hidden motifs equally while holding seeds, filler-state trajectory, selector, motif budget, controls, metrics, and thresholds unchanged, can the existing Wingless substrate causally discover reusable four-byte motifs from an unsegmented raw-byte stream?
hypothesis: With balanced eight-motif exposure, the unchanged WBG-2 selector will recover at least seven of eight hidden predictive motifs, achieve at least 0.95 held-out successor accuracy, exceed its byte-only ablation by at least 0.70 accuracy, reduce effective evaluation events by at least 0.30, and show no comparable gain from shuffled learned motifs. Slice and ring byte-window substrates will agree exactly.

prior_evidence.attribution_claim: Each R2 seed exposed exactly two hidden motifs, and the unchanged selector recovered all presented true motifs.

authority: research-only; no production, live, accepted-ref, scheduler, queue-consumer, external-model inference, or cross-lane authority changes

paired_single_variable_delta.reason_for_seed_reuse: Intentional paired comparison to R2; same seeds preserve the prior LCG/filler trajectory while isolating motif-support scheduling.
paired_single_variable_delta.only_change: Motif id no longer uses state mod 8. After preserving the same otherwise-unused first LCG advance per record, motif id is (5*record + seed mod 8) mod 8, so every eight records expose all eight motifs exactly once.

corpora.train_eval_separation: Evaluation retains the original R2 alternate LCG initial state; balanced motif scheduling applies independently to both.

validity_criteria: Exact parent SHA, North Star identity, R2 negative evidence, and attribution evidence match this preregistration.
The only corpus-generation semantic change from R2 is motif-ID scheduling; the LCG still advances once before motif emission and three times for filler bytes per record.
Every training seed contains each hidden motif exactly 512 times and every evaluation seed exactly 256 times.
The selector/filter/ranking/budget and all R2 controls and thresholds remain byte-equivalent in behavior.
No boundary bytes, motif IDs, or labels are exposed to selection.
The normalized result carries schema wingless.research-scientific-result.v1 and the exact experiment identifier.
Full Go regression passes before probe execution.

classification_rules.supported: All sixteen original WBG-2 frozen scientific thresholds and all validity criteria pass.
classification_rules.mixed: Validity passes and motif-enabled prediction causally exceeds controls, but at least one motif recovery, event reduction, or exact-equivalence threshold fails.
classification_rules.negative: Validity passes but balanced support does not produce causal motif discovery under the unchanged selector.
classification_rules.incomplete: Environmental or compute interruption prevents frozen cardinality.
classification_rules.invalid: Provenance, paired single-variable identity, balanced-support construction, raw-byte isolation, bounded selector, deterministic execution, or qualification isolation fails.

no_post_result_tuning_rule: Do not alter seeds, balanced schedule, filler trajectory, selector, candidate filter, motif budget, controls, event accounting, metrics, thresholds, or classification after any output is observed.
